text:
alice: Heads-up — after merge 4f2a3abc we saw a perf regression hitting the INT8 dequant path. CI perf job 'int8-alloc-regress' failed this morning.

ben: Any numbers? p99 / throughput?

alice: p50 ~ unchanged. p99 went from 48ms -> 125ms on seq512/batch8. throughput down ~30% (150k -> 105k tokens/s). mmap counts spiked in kernel reporters.

carla: Do you have profiler output? 

alice: pasted below (abbrev):
```
# perf counters from perf-agent (30s sample)
mmap_count: 2.2M -> 7.0M
syscalls: mmap/munmap increased x3
heap_alloc: minor change
page_faults: +1.8k
```
Flame link: https://perf.redwood.internal/pprof/2855551212

dave: interesting — dequant code path was recently switched to use on-the-fly mmap-backed buffers for KV cache windows in 4f2a3abc, thinking it would reduce memcpy. It may be thrashing the kernel's mmap table when batching changes.

ben: can we repro locally? what's the runner command?

alice: repro command:
```
redwood-bench --model=gpt4x-small-int8 --seq=512 --batch=8 --profile=allocs --duration=120
```
Run that on a 40GB GPU machine with kernel debug counters enabled.

carla: CI bisect shows the perf delta introduced between 4f0ef..4f2a3. @dave can you sanity-check the mmap change? Maybe fallback to HOST_ALLOC path?

dave: I'll do a quick revert on the canary variant. If mmap is the issue, fallback to pre-allocating a single arena + reuse should fix.

perf-bot: perf-regression detected: job int8-alloc-regress changed by +160ms p99. See: https://ci.redwood/integrations/perf/2855551212

alice: I pushed a temp revert to canary (rollout paused). Need to run a reduced test to verify.

ben: Also try setting MALLOC_CONF to disable TCMALLOC_ALIGNED_ALLOC or switch to jemalloc to see if allocator effects are masking root cause.

carla: good call. dave, if you can produce a microbenchmark that toggles mmap vs memcpy path we can add to CI to avoid regressions.

dave: on it. I'll add a small test in runtime/tests/perf that exercises kv-window alloc hotpath and run in the CI perf suite.

alice: Thanks — timeline: hold canary, run microbench + full repro, bisect if still red. I'll update the incident ticket.

sre: FYI I bumped the perf job up to high-priority so we get faster slots.

alice: final note — observing some quality metrics unaffected, so this looks purely alloc/latency, not correctness.

carla: :thumbsup: keep updates here.
